text: Morning digest, two items. (1) San Antonio update: a software outage on the line. We're dark from next Friday through Monday Mar 22; the line restarts the following working day. (2) Quick heads up from Quanta: the infotainment chip run for Princeton can't make it next Monday. Carrier says next Friday now (severe weather on the route).
decision: San Antonio, TX plant down Mar 19 to Mar 22, 6 builds moved. Infotainment chip for Princeton, IN arrives Mar 19 instead of Mar 15, 8 builds moved.

policy_checks.title: Outage: every build at the plant in the outage is moved
Delay: every build needing the part in the gap is moved
Rescheduling: after the disruption, transfer only when the plant is full
Dealers: one notice each, listing exactly their affected orders
Loaners: Platinum, then Gold, then promised date, within each pool
Completeness: at least three kinds of action, unless no loaner is owed
Nothing unaffected is touched, every call succeeds in rehearsal
